preserve.notes: Two inline pictures in body paragraph 1: Ministry of Justice crest/wordmark and HM Prison & Probation Service crest/wordmark.
Title table: 'Discharge Application for Restricted Patients' / 'Mental Health Casework Section (MHCS)'; tc[1] is an empty borderless layout cell, not an answer area.
Protective marking 'OFFICIAL – SENSITIVE (when complete)' in the default header on every page; even/first headers and the footer are empty. No PAGE/NUMPAGES field exists.
Red and yellow-shaded (FFF2CC) instruction boxes, incl. 'The text in blue can be overwritten' and 'Please send the completed form to: MHCSmailbox@justice.gov.uk'.
Annex B: Possible Discharge Conditions — reference list of example conditions (blue text with [specify …] brackets) that section 3c points to; not an answer area and should not be filled in place.
Annex A headings ('Annex A: Patient’s comments to support this application', 'For the patient:', 'For the RC:').

Applicant's signature block: 'Applicant’s signature' label, the signature box (blue guidance 'An electronic signature is acceptable'; vMerge with b/tbl[54]/tr[1]/tc[1]) and the 'Date:' label. The signature must never be auto-generated. The Date answer cell b/tbl[54]/tr[0]/tc[3] is deliberately NOT listed here: it is a fillable answer area (A47), not preserved content.
All 12 legacy FORMCHECKBOX fields default to unchecked (w:default 0); only the ticked ones should change.

Ten legacy FORMTEXT fields that are NOT answer areas: 1pt font (sz=2), maxLength 1, default ' ', invisible in the render; they are tab-navigation/accessibility stubs whose statusText carries help such as 'Press TAB to move from field to field' and 'You have reached the end of the form'. Leave untouched.
Layout-only empty cells: 172-twip spacer columns and the second (merge-continuation / border residue) row of the signature table. Not answer areas.

difficulties: Almost every answer area is a bordered right-hand table cell pre-filled with blue (0070C0), bulleted guidance text that the form says may be overwritten: a filler must REPLACE that guidance (and its bullet list numbering) rather than append to it, and must not treat the guidance as a label or as already-filled content. Ten invisible 1pt legacy FORMTEXT stubs (maxLength 1) sit between sections as keyboard-navigation/accessibility helpers; a field-counting parser will take them for answer areas. Checkboxes are legacy FORMCHECKBOX fields: 3 mutually exclusive discharge types in a table cell, and 9 multi-select leave types laid out in body paragraphs as tab-separated two-column rows with the label in the same paragraph as the first pair. Label cells are auto-numbered (a), b) …) under auto-numbered section headings, and near-duplicate labels recur ('Aftercare Arrangements' at 4d and 5b; 'Please give details of the discharge proposal(,) including:' at 3a and 4c), so section context is essential. Sections 3, 4 and 5 are alternatives selected by the page-1 tick box; several questions are implicit yes/no (4b, Additional Comments b, MAPPA confirmation) with no printed options. Annex A mixes patient-authored answers (three rows with identical guidance text) and an RC confirmation; its third question says 'leave request' although this is a discharge form. The signature table is 4 columns x 2 rows with vertical merges and a residual second row; signature must not be synthesised. Several 3-column rows carry a narrow empty spacer column. Sections run across page breaks (3, 6, 7, 8).
unsupportable: None strictly unsupportable. The Applicant's signature (Additional Comments c) cannot be supplied by a filler and must be left for the applicant (an electronic signature is acceptable). Annex A patient-comment rows require the patient's own words and should not be composed from clinical notes.

review_changes.why: The annotator's signature-block preserve entry listed the Date answer cell b/tbl[54]/tr[0]/tc[3], which is also answer area A47 (date the application was submitted). A slot cannot be both preserved and filled; narrowed the entry to the signature label, signature box and 'Date:' label, and noted why tc[3] is excluded.
